disclosure: General industry pattern on call answer behavior, not tied to a specific report

claims.text: Most calls from unrecognized numbers go unanswered, and a 'Spam Likely' tag can cut answer rates by half or more
Carriers flag numbers based on patterns like no caller ID name on file or bursts of outbound calls
CNAM registration is typically a standard request handled by a phone or VoIP provider within a few business days
Texting a lead before calling back can warm recognition and improve pickup, and this step can run automatically on the Black Arrow platform
